name: PLOD1
summary: PLOD1, fragile foal syndrome - a recessive lethal: an affected foal does not survive. Wild horses can carry one copy silently; two carriers bred together are the only way it appears.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: PLOD1 carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of ffs. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way fragile foal syndrome appears.

phenotypes.name: Fragile foal syndrome
phenotypes.description: A collagen defect: the skin tears at a touch and the joints will not hold. The foal is born alive and does not survive it.
